# Know Your Meme

> > A comprehensive database documenting internet memes, viral trends, and digital culture phenomena across platforms like TikTok, Twitter, and YouTube.

Know Your Meme serves as the definitive encyclopedia for understanding the origins, evolution, and cultural context of internet memes. The site features both individual meme entries and editorial guides explaining viral trends, with a focus on social media phenomena and participatory culture.

## Key Topics

- TikTok trends and viral videos
- Exploitable memes and image macros
- Viral memes and catchphrases
- Dance memes and challenges
- Social media platforms (TikTok, Twitter, YouTube)
- Meme culture and digital folklore
- Pop culture references
- Internet humor and relatability
- Meme origins and explanations
- Visual meme formats
- Music-based memes
- Nostalgia and throwback culture
- Platform-specific trends

## Featured Memes

- [Jesse, What the Fuck Are You Talking About](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/jesse-what-the-fuck-are-you-talking-about): Breaking Bad dialogue meme featuring Walter White & Jesse Pinkman confusion
- [We Still Talk About You](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/we-still-talk-about-you): Exploitable meme featuring heartbreaking art of girl with cat, viral on TikTok

## Viral Trend Guides

- [What Do The Memes About Hearing Saxophones In The Hood Mean?](https://trending.knowyourmeme.com/editorials/guides/what-do-the-memes-about-hearing-saxophones-in-the-hood-mean-the-viral-90s-hood-movie-trend-explained): Guide explaining Boyz n the Hood saxophone meme trend on TikTok & Instagram
- [Who Is The 'Bananas And Rice' Girl?](https://trending.knowyourmeme.com/editorials/guides/who-is-the-bananas-and-rice-girl-the-viral-memes-about-somali-american-ice-victim-nasra-ahmed-explained): Guide explaining Nasra Ahmed viral ICE incident memes from Minneapolis speech

## TikTok Trends

- [I'm Talking About Innit](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/im-talking-about-innit): TikTok dance trend based on BunnaB & YKNiece's 'Innit' with swimming gesture

## Meme Collections

- [22 Memes About Mental Health That Are A Little Too Relatable](https://trending.knowyourmeme.com/editorials/collections/22-memes-about-mental-health-that-are-a-little-too-relatable): Collection of 22 relatable memes about depression, anxiety & mental health
